insights.summary: From Arihant's Bharat Connect compendium (September 2026 conference, published 5 October): management has raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to at least 60% over FY26, from 40% on the July call (20% at the start of the year), calls Q1's 23.25% EBITDA margin sustainable, and sees ~50%+ growth as sustainable beyond FY27 on a ~₹28,000 Cr order book. Capex has been lifted to ~₹2,500 Cr over 2-2.5 years (₹1,000 Cr in each of FY27 and FY28), including a 600-tonne preform plant by October 2028, and defence ambitions to ₹4,000-5,000 Cr by FY30. Fibre prices have roughly tripled on a hyperscaler-driven shortage; EPC losses of ₹80-90 Cr a quarter should end within two quarters.
